scheduler.description: Scheduler is running or stopped, as the command left it.

changed.description:
Changed is whether the command started or stopped it (false: it
already was).

uiStopped.description:
UIStopped is whether stop stopped a running menu bar app or tray
(besides the one that ran it, if one did).

title: procauto login-items stop --json
description: RunningOutput is `login-items start --json` and `login-items stop --json`: whether the scheduler runs now, and what the command changed.
